theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_allard_fdsb_density_cylinder_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (P : Grassmannian N n) (y : Euclidean N) (θ : ℝ≥0∞) (ε K : ℝ), 0 ≤ ε → Real.exp ε ≤ 2 → 0 ≤ K → (∀ σ : ℝ, 0 < σ → σ < 1 → θ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (ε * σ)) * densityRatio n μ y σ) → (∀ τ σ ρ : ℝ, 0 < τ → τ ≤ 1 → 0 < σ → σ ≤ ρ → ρ < 1 → μ (closedBall y σ ∩ {z | ‖(z - y) - Grassmannian.project P (z - y)‖ < τ}) / ENNReal.ofReal σ ^ n ≤ μ (closedBall y ρ ∩ {z | ‖(z - y) - Grassmannian.project P (z - y)‖ < 2 * τ}) / ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n + ENNReal.ofReal (K * ε * ρ / τ)) → ∀ τ σ : ℝ, 0 < τ → τ ≤ 1 / 4 → 0 < σ → σ < 1 → θ ≤ (ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp ε) * (μ (closedBall y σ ∩ {z | ‖(z - y) - Grassmannian.project P (z - y)‖ < 4 * τ}) / ENNReal.ofReal σ ^ n) + ENNReal.ofReal (K * ε * σ / τ)) / unitBallVolume n
